exposure: mild pre-eclampsia vs severe pre-eclampsia vs healthy pregnant
outcome: IL-17 and IL-35 concentrations in the serum and placental tissue
cohort: 90 pregnant women with pre-eclampsia (45 with severe pre-eclampsia and 45 with mild pre-eclampsia) and 45 healthy pregnant women
finding: Serum and placental IL-17 levels were significantly higher in PE patients than in healthy pregnant women, while IL-35 expression was significantly lower in severe PE placental tissue and serum compared with normal pregnant women.
mod_finding: All 135 pregnant women in the study underwent cesarean delivery.
